chief_complaint: Shortness of breath and persistent cough for the past week, worse with exertion.
doctor_notes: Patient presents with symptoms suggestive of pneumonia. Auscultation reveals crackles in the right lower lobe. Chest X-ray confirms consolidation. BP elevated, likely due to infection and stress. Continue current hypertension medication. Advised on hydration and rest. Follow up in 7 days.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Doctor, I've been having this terrible cough and can't seem to catch my breath for the last week.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. Tell me more about when it started and if anything makes it worse.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: It started gradually, but the last few days have been much worse, especially when I try to walk around.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Okay, I've listened to your lungs and I'm seeing some signs of infection. We'll need to do some tests and likely start antibiotics.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Will I be okay? I'm worried about this shortness of breath.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: With the right treatment, you should start feeling better within a few days. We'll monitor you closely.
